riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who enjoy finding large questions in small details. They can sustain patient scholarship, manage fieldwork, and keep their curiosity active.
riasec_fit_block.interest: Discovery itself makes this work compelling. A pottery fragment, an interview, or a cultural pattern can change how you understand the world. People who keep asking why, seek evidence in the field, and tolerate long periods of patient work can find lasting satisfaction here.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Artistic A + Social S

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合享受「在细节里发现大问题」的人——冷板凳坐得住，田野跑得动，好奇心永远在线。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的吸引力在于「发现」本身——一块陶片、一段访谈、一个文化现象，都可能改写你对世界的理解。喜欢追根问底、愿意去现场、能坐得住冷板凳的人，会在这里找到持久的乐趣。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 艺术型 A + 社会型 S

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you enjoy the full journey from imagining a dance to performing and sharing it, choreography offers complete artistic satisfaction. Every work also carries your name.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The reward comes from seeing creation recognized. Your dance is performed, enters competitions, stays with audiences, and moves people. Choreography also gains depth with age as experience and aesthetic judgment accumulate.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Artistic A + Enterprising E + Social S

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你享受「一段舞从想到跳、从跳到被看见」的全过程，编舞会给艺术创作的人最完整的满足感——而且每部作品都会留下你的名字。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的快感来自「创造被看见」：你编的舞被演出、被比赛、被观众记住，有人因为你的作品被打动；而且编舞是个「越老越有味道」的行业，经验和审美会沉淀。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 艺术型 A + 企业型 E + 社会型 S

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine steadiness + rigor + curiosity about data. Definitions must align and remain explainable, while modeling and governance stay balanced under accountability for consistency.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops the ability to create order from messy data. It requires modeling knowledge and patience in aligning definitions. It suits grounded, rigorous people who accept responsibility for consistency and enjoy turning unreliable numbers into trusted data.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers investigative, practical, and structured work (Investigative I + Realistic R + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「踏实 + 严谨 + 爱琢磨数据」凑一块的人——口径要对得齐也要讲得清，建模和治理要平衡也要会扛一致性。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在杂乱里立规矩」——既要懂建模，也要有把口径对齐的耐心。适合踏实、严谨、又能对一致性负责的人，也享受从乱数到可信的过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好研究、务实、也常规（研究 I + 实务 R + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career combines attention to detail, patience, and empathy. Benefits must go to the right people, and applicants must still feel heard.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work depends on accuracy and empathy because both incorrect payments and missed eligible applicants cause harm. It suits careful, patient people who balance rules with human circumstances.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers organized, rule-based work that also serves people (Conventional C + Enterprising E + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细心 + 有耐心 + 会共情」凑一块的人——发得要准，人也接得住。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最讲的是「准与温度」——错发漏发都伤人。适合细心、有耐心、又愿意在制度和人之间找平衡的人，共情是底色。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好有条理、重规则、也愿助人（常规 C + 企业 E + 社会 S）。

breadcrumb.label: English Language And Literature Teachers, Postsecondary

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This role suits people who treat reading as a way of life and teaching literature as a passion. The moment a student sees a text differently is the reward.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The pleasure of this work comes from moments when students understand people through text. A difficult novel can suddenly speak to a class. Faculty must love reading and teaching books while enduring up-or-out research pressure.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Social S + Artistic A

breadcrumb.label: 高校英语语言文学教师

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「把读书当生活、把讲书当爱好」的人——学生眼里亮起来的那一下，就是你最大的回报。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的乐趣在「把人读懂的瞬间」：学生突然想通一段文本时的眼神，一节课把一篇难懂的小说讲进人心里的畅快。你既要爱读书，又要爱讲书，还要耐得住高校「非升即走」的科研压力。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 社会型 S + 艺术型 A

breadcrumb.label: First Line Supervisors Of Security Workers

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who enjoy leading a team and taking responsibility on site. An orderly security unit reflects the supervisor's work.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The satisfaction comes from leading a team. Organizing personnel and stabilizing an emergency bring concrete responsibility and achievement. People who enjoy management, accept pressure, and tolerate night duty find purpose in the role.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising E + Social S + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合享受「带队伍、扛现场」的人——一支运转有序的保安队，就是你的作品。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的成就感来自「带得动队伍」——你把一帮人调度好、把一场突发事件处置稳，责任和成就感都实打实。喜欢管人、能扛事、愿意值夜班的人，会在这里找到存在感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 企业型 E + 社会型 S + 事务型 C

breadcrumb.label: Furnace, Kiln, Oven, Drier, And Kettle Operators And Tenders

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This occupation suits steady, patient people who enjoy studying processes. Heat control is a discipline that rewards lifelong learning.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This occupation offers the grounded satisfaction of technical craft. The same material becomes a premium product when heat is controlled well and an entire batch can be lost when it is not. Mastering the process brings tangible achievement.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Investigative (I)

breadcrumb.label: 炉窑干燥设备操作与看护员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「稳得住、有耐心、喜欢琢磨工艺」的人——火候这门学问，值得研究一辈子。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行有股「技术活儿」的踏实感：同样的料，火候拿捏得好，出的是优等品；拿捏不好，一炉全废。把火候吃透，是很有成就感的事。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 研究型 I

breadcrumb.label: Helpers Brickmasons, Blockmasons, Stonemasons, And Tile And Marble Setters

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The tangible reward is skill growing in your own hands. Moving from carrying masonry to independently building a wall or setting a floor raises both value and rates. Crews share hard work and straightforward relationships that many workers come to value.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work provides a starting point for learning a trade from zero. Following experienced workers builds masonry and tile-setting ability day by day, creating visible growth from carrying materials to independent craft. Worksite relationships are often direct and uncomplicated.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Enterprising (E)

breadcrumb.label: 帮工砌砖工、砌块工、石匠、瓷砖大理石铺设工

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最实在的是「手艺一步步长在自己身上」：从只会搬砖到能独立砌一面墙、贴一地面砖，你的价值在涨、工价在涨；工地上大家一起扛活、收工吃顿好的，简单直接的相处方式，很多人干久了反而离不开。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行给的是「从零学起的手艺起点」：跟着师傅一天天把砌墙、贴砖的功夫学到手，从只会搬砖到能独立上手，成长感很具体；工地上的工友也大多直来直去，处起来简单。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 常规型 C + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine steady hands + attention to detail + aesthetic judgment. Teeth must be aligned and adjusted accurately, requiring a balance of treatment and communication and an ability to reassure patients.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops precision and patience. Your hands must be steady, your plans accurate, and your patients reassured. It suits people with steady hands, sustained focus, and high aesthetic standards who enjoy the achievement of restoring a smile.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical work, investigation, and helping others (Realistic R + Investigative I + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「手稳 + 细心 + 美学感」凑一块的人——牙要排得齐也要调得准，疗程和沟通要平衡也要会哄。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「精细与耐心」——手要稳、方案要准、患者要哄得住。适合动手稳、坐得住、对美学有要求的人，也享受把笑容矫正回来的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、研究、也助人（现实 R + 研究 I + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine investigation + calmness + responsibility. Optical paths must be stable and devices accurate, requiring a balance of precision and process with hands-on ability.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops precision with light. Engineers must understand optics, materials, and electronics and tune devices for stable mass production. It suits calm, investigative people who accept responsibility for yield and enjoy the complete journey from prototype to production.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers investigation and practical work (Investigative I + Realistic R + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「钻研 + 沉静 + 责任感」凑一块的人——光路要调得稳、器件要出得准，精度和工艺要平衡也要会动手。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「光里的精确」——既要懂光学、材料与电，也要把器件调到量产稳。适合沉静、钻研、又愿意对良率负责的人，也享受从样机到量产的全程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好钻研与务实（调研 I + 务实 R + 秩序 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine extroversion, writing, and resilience. They can plan responses during a storm and cultivate relationships across multiple parties.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops a sense of timing. The same statement can have completely different effects when released in the morning versus at night. It suits outgoing, quick-thinking people who write well and handle pressure, moving between spotlights and storms.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers interpersonal influence and creative expression (Enterprising E + Social A + Artistic A).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「外向 + 会写 + 扛压」凑一块的人——能在风暴里排回应节奏，也经营得动几头关系。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「节奏感」——同一个声明，早上发和晚上发效果天差地别。适合外向、反应快、既会写又能扛压的人，在聚光灯和风暴之间来回走。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好重人际影响、也善表达创意（企业 E + 社会 A + 艺术 A）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who understand finances, negotiate, and handle pressure. Every purchase is the result of balancing numbers and relationships, and protecting costs is the skill.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The satisfaction in this work is tangible. Comparing quotes and negotiating a raw material's unit price can save millions over a year. Replacing an unreliable supplier can keep a production line running smoothly. Purchasing deals with numbers and relationships every day, and every amount saved is a concrete result.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising E + Conventional C + Realistic R

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「会算账、会谈判、又扛得住压力」的人——采购的每一单都是数字和人情博弈的结果，把成本守住就是本事。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的成就感很实在：一款原料通过比价和谈判把单价压下来，一年能省下几百万；换掉一个老出问题的供应商，产线从此顺了。采购天天跟数字和人情打交道，省下的每一分都是硬成绩。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 企业型 E + 常规型 C + 现实型 R

breadcrumb.label: Separating, Filtering, Clarifying, Precipitating, And Still Machine Setters, Operators, And Tenders

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine practicality, hands-on ability, and patience. Parameters must remain stable and accurate, while operators balance safety and capacity.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops vigilance amid repetition. You need to understand processes and calculate parameters while noticing problems within machinery noise. It suits practical, hands-on people willing to tend equipment who enjoy the full process from startup to stable operation.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: They tend to be hands-on, organized, and investigative (Realistic R + Conventional C + Investigative I).

breadcrumb.label: 机器铺设工、操作员、看护员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「踏实 + 动手 + 能守」凑一块的人——参数要稳也要准，安全和产能要平衡也要会守。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「重复里的警觉」——既要懂工艺和参数算得清，也要有在轰鸣里听出毛病的细心。适合踏实、动手强、又愿意守设备的人，也享受从开机到平稳的全过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好实操、规矩、也钻研（现实 R + 常规 C + 研究 I）。
